critical_code_review_comments: Minor: GET /api/maintenance/scan/{token} returns already_submitted=true when a maintenance slot exists but records array is empty (e.g. after admin manually deletes a record). Consider deriving already_submitted purely from records count so state stays consistent after audit corrections. Non-blocking.
